name: integration-and-release
architecture: Neural Orchestra v5 Contract-First Vertical Slicing
description: Standard operating procedure for merging parallel code streams, resolving conflicts, validating builds, running comprehensive test suites, and signing off on release.

phases.name: Zero-Token Deterministic Quality Gate
phases.instructions: Execute node .agents/bin/quality-gate.mjs to verify conflict markers, TypeScript compiler checks, professional-ui-craft rules, and dependency audits.

phases.name: E2E Validation & Security Sign-Off
phases.instructions: Run automated browser E2E test suites, security penetration scans, and git diff audits.

phases.name: Runtime Observability & Health Probes Verification
phases.instructions: Verify /health and /ready probe endpoints, structured logging format, and metric outputs.

phases.name: Semantic Versioning & Release Packaging
phases.instructions: Bump semantic version, generate CHANGELOG.md, and package release artifacts.
